lines.targetText: Good morning, Laith. Did you help in a kitchen when you were a child?

lines.targetText: Good morning. No, but I used to watch my mother bake bread.

lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير. No, but I used to watch my mother bake bread.
lines.pronunciation: Good morning. No, but I used to watch my mother bake bread.

lines.arabicTranslation: Yes. It reminds me of home.
lines.pronunciation: Yes. It reminds me of home.

lines.targetText: Can you put these loaves on the shelf?

lines.arabicTranslation: Can you put these loaves on the shelf?

lines.targetText: Of course. I can do that now.

lines.arabicTranslation: Of course. I can do that now.
